an5.135:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa jeṭṭho putto rajjaṃ pattheti
an5.135:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa jeṭṭho putto ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena
an5.135:1.4: abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato
an5.135:1.7: yāni tāni raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhābhisittānaṃ sippuṭṭhānāni hatthismiṃ vā assasmiṃ vā rathasmiṃ vā dhanusmiṃ vā tattha sikkhito hoti anavayo
an5.135:2.2: ahaṃ khomhi ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena
an5.135:2.4: ahaṃ khomhi abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato
an5.135:2.10: ahaṃ khomhi yāni tāni raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhābhisittānaṃ sippuṭṭhānāni hatthismiṃ vā assasmiṃ vā rathasmiṃ vā dhanusmiṃ vā tattha sikkhito anavayo
an5.135:2.12: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa jeṭṭho putto rajjaṃ pattheti
an5.135:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pattheti
an5.135:3.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an5.135:3.5: appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya
an5.135:3.6: asaṭho hoti amāyāvī yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu
an5.135:3.7: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an5.135:3.8: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
an5.135:4.2: ahaṃ khomhi saddho saddahāmi tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an5.135:4.5: ahaṃ khomhi appābādho appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya
an5.135:4.7: ahaṃ khomhi asaṭho amāyāvī yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu
an5.135:4.9: ahaṃ khomhi āraddhaviriyo viharāmi akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya …pe… anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an5.135:4.13: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ patthetīti.
